title: How much input remains eligible for this query?
description: Choose a table layout, time window, and projection. The model separates directory pruning from column pruning and exposes when fine partitions trade fewer bytes for more catalog and file work.

layouts.label: Unpartitioned TextFile
layouts.detail: One table directory, 2,920 modeled input files, and no column pruning.

layouts.label: Unpartitioned ORC
layouts.detail: The date filter cannot remove directories, but selected columns can narrow the modeled input.

layouts.label: Daily partitions + ORC
layouts.detail: A bounded catalog with eight modeled files per day and column pruning.

layouts.label: Hourly partitions + ORC
layouts.detail: Narrow time windows open fewer bytes, while broad queries enumerate many partitions.
